{{Quote|You were instructed not to serve the dameapple turnovers until after the skewered runis!|Roy Teda|<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />}}
'''Skewered runis''' was a food available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romin]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]. During a party hosted by Romin's [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictator]], [[Roy Teda]], skewered runis was served. [[Dameapple turnover]]s were planned to be served after the runis, but the party's waitstaff brought the dishes out in the wrong order.<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />

*''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]'' {{1stm}}
